implementation: Original code written against dskcpy interfaces; no upstream implementation copied or cherry-picked. Earlier reference exposure precludes a formal isolated clean-room claim.
packet_scope: Inherited native media packet body. Existing custom session headers, reverse SRD1 framing and browser limits unchanged.
utf8_scope: Bounded cut search; valid boundaries and full-string behavior preserved, no new whole-string validation policy.
timeout_contract: Single use after init; inputs published before worker creation; stop suppresses unclaimed expiration; callback outside mutex may call stop; join completes an already claimed callback; condition init failure releases mutex.

verification.real_threads: 128 immediate expirations plus stop-before-start, immediate stop and signaled-then-stop cases using SDL workers
verification.mock_fixtures: Allocation/read probes, exact upper boundary with injected OOM, valid payload/PTS/config/keyframe and short reads; deterministic timeout init/create failures, immediate worker scheduling, spurious signals and wait-return cancellation

physical_verification: None in this change; existing Mac/browser audio and hardware gates remain open.
limits: Homebrew-linked local candidate is not a portable macOS 13 release
No dependency, Android companion, UI or browser source change
No account, public relay, release/signing configuration or active stream change
